title: Falling crucifix kills priest during Mass in Ecuador
summary: GUAYAQUIL, Ecuador — A Catholic priest died Saturday when a wooden crucifix fell from a wall and crushed him against the pulpit as he celebrated Mass in the Ecuadorian city of Guayaquil.…

blocks.text: GUAYAQUIL, Ecuador — A Catholic priest died Saturday when a wooden crucifix fell from a wall and crushed him against the pulpit as he celebrated Mass in the Ecuadorian city of Guayaquil. “Father, Father! Call an ambulance!” people at Our Lady of Perpetual Help church could be heard shouting just before a livestreamed broadcast cuts out. READ: Veteran ‘Kristo’ ends 37-year crucifixion on Good Friday The graphic footage of the accident went viral Sunday on social media and was widely carried by news outlets.
